effects.name: 自然饱和度
known_differences: Adds explicit saturated-color protection to the adapted vibrance formula; no automatic skin classification.

effects.name: 渐变
known_differences: Four evenly spaced, animatable premultiplied color stops; HSV wheel is distinct from directional rainbow.

effects.name: 流动渐变
known_differences: Five deterministic animated points; not a free curved mesh or an exact port of upstream MeshGradient.

effects.name: 网格渐变
known_differences: Fixed 4×4 regular grid with bilinear color interpolation; vertices and grid curves are not freely movable.

effects.name: 噪声生成器
known_differences: Independent seeded kernels, not MaterialX-compatible hashes. Blue mode uses a spectrally checked static tile; octaves apply to Perlin.

effects.name: 旋流噪声
known_differences: RG stores the analytic 2D curl in display-RGB data channels, neutral 0.5; clipping, RGBA8 quantization and texture interpolation can alter the encoded field.

effects.name: 碳纤维
known_differences: 2D woven surface and clearcoat approximation, not shape-aware physical lighting.

effects.name: 拉丝金属
known_differences: 2D directional surface; no scene light or shape-bound normal input.

effects.name: 极光
known_differences: Bounded procedural curtain field, independently implemented; no volumetric scene integration.

effects.name: 弯曲
known_differences: Adapted inverse parabolic-sheet projection; no integration with the scene's 3D mesh or camera.

effects.name: 拉伸
known_differences: Local directional stretch with Gaussian falloff, independent of layer transform scale.

effects.name: 四角定位
known_differences: Convex perspective quads; degenerate and self-intersecting quads produce transparent output.

effects.name: CRT 显像管
known_differences: Includes barrel curvature and a fixed four-neighbour glow approximation; alpha follows warped source.

effects.name: 字符画
known_differences: Shared font rasterizer can supply a coverage-sorted custom atlas; original ten-glyph bitmap atlas is the default.

effects.name: 投影
known_differences: Finite Gaussian support with up to 33 taps per axis; bounds include offset and full blur support.

effects.name: 通道模糊
known_differences: Separate Gaussian radius and sampling for each RGB channel; alpha preserved, transparent samples coverage-normalised.

effects.name: 区域模糊
known_differences: Separable spatially varying Gaussian approximation; final pass restores exact source pixels inside the focus band.

effects.name: 散景模糊
known_differences: 16/32/64 deterministic aperture taps; polygon and circular apertures, no temporal accumulation or cat-eye model.

effects.name: 置换贴图
known_differences: Layer input defaults to same-frame masked/effected pixels; optional source stage excludes masks/effects. Transforms/opacity are excluded; input is stretched to the destination source rectangle; inactive source is neutral.

effects.name: 压缩失真
known_differences: Same-frame separable 8×8 DCT/quantization, RGBA8 coefficient precision; not full JPEG encoding or exact codec parity.
